background.narutorpg.academy_prodigy.des: Top of your Academy class. Deep chakra reserves, a head start in rank and the textbook techniques mastered early.
background.narutorpg.anbu_trainee.desc: Pulled from the Academy into the black-ops program. Precise, lethal and trained in silent infiltration.
background.narutorpg.merchant_scion.desc: Heir of a trading or crafting house. Lucky, well connected, and well supplied with the finest ninja tools money can buy.
background.narutorpg.shinobi_orphan.desc: Raised by nobody, you learned to survive on the streets: tougher, quicker on your feet, never without a spare blade.
background.narutorpg.wandering_mercenary: You sold your blade from one war-torn country to the next. Armoured, hard to kill, but with little chakra training.
faction.narutorpg.bamboo_village.desc: Bamboo Village is a small village in the Land of Hot Water. It is surrounded by a forest of bamboo, and as such most of the village's buildings and goods are made out of bamboo.
faction.narutorpg.ceramic_village.desc: The Ceramic Village was a small village in the Land of Wind, near the border with the Land of Rivers.
faction.narutorpg.curtain_village.desc: Curtain Village is the capital of the Land of Silence. The city hosts the only black market in the region.
faction.narutorpg.daidai_village.desc: Daidai Village is a small village inhabited by the members of the Yoimura Clan.
This unnamed village is hidden among special trees that produce a genjutsu-like effect, thus protecting the village from invaders.
faction.narutorpg.hacho_village.desc: Hachō Village is a village lying on the outskirts of the border of the Land of Fire. They are on very friendly terms with the Tonika Village.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_cloud.desc: Kumogakure is the hidden village of the Land of Lightning and was founded by the First Raikage.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_dream.desc: is a small village located in a deep forest of a tiny country, near the border of the Land of Fire.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_frost.desc: Shimogakure is the hidden village located in the Land of Frost.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_grass.desc: Kusagakure is located thus far in an unnamed country. Because it had genin participating in the Chūnin Exams organised by Konohagakure, it can be assumed the two villages are allied.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_hot_water.desc: Yugakure is the hidden village of the Land of Hot Water. Like the country in which it resides, Yugakure has strong inclinations towards pacifism.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_leaf.desc: Konohagakure is the hidden village of the Land of Fire. As the village of one of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, Konohagakure has a Kage as its leader known as the Hokage, of which there have been seven in its history.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_mist.desc: Kirigakure is the hidden village of the Land of Water. As the village of one of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, Kiri has a Kage as its leader known as the Mizukage, of which there have been six in its history.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_moon.desc: Tsukigakure is a hidden village led by Tsukino, who succeeded her father after he died. They have a hereditary system and so positions are passed down to the next generation.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_rain.desc: Amegakure is a small but highly industrialised hidden village located in an unnamed country.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_rock.desc: Ishigakure is the hidden village of the country located between the Land of Earth and the Land of Wind.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_sand.desc: Sunagakure is the hidden village of the Land of Wind. As the village of one of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, Sunagakure has a Kage as its leader known as the Kazekage, of which there have been five in its history.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_snow.desc: Yukigakure is a hidden village located in the Land of Snow. Its ninja apparently specialise in manipulating pre-existing ice, typically in the forms of various animals.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_sound.desc: Otogakure is the personal hidden village of Orochimaru, which was founded after he left the Akatsuki for the express purpose of collecting ninja for his experiments and his quest to learn all techniques.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_star.desc: Hoshigakure was introduced during the Star Guard Mission. It is founded by the First Hoshikage two hundred years before the start of the series and is located in the Land of Bears.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_stone.desc: Iwagakure is the hidden village of the Land of Earth. As the village of one of the Five Great Shinobi Countries, Iwagakure has a Kage as its leader known as the Tsuchikage, of which there have been four in its history.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_valley.desc: Tanigakure is the hidden village of the Land of Rivers. Thirty years before the start of the series, this village ambushed Kagerō Village two weeks after they had agreed to a ceasefire with Konohagakure.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_waterfall.desc: Takigakure is a village located in an unnamed country. Their current leader is Shibuki.
faction.narutorpg.hidden_whirlpool.desc: Uzushiogakure was the shinobi village of the Land of Whirlpools. The people of Uzushiogakure were noted to have notoriously long lives, so it gained the epithet "The Village of Longevity".
faction.narutorpg.howling_wolf_village.d: The Howling Wolf Village was originally a settlement of the Kodon clan. Since ancient times, the settlement was periodically attacked by Rōen, a wolf-like monster.
faction.narutorpg.inaho_village.desc: Inaho Village is located near the hills where Genmai was kidnapped.
faction.narutorpg.jomae_village.desc: The Jōmae Village is an anime-only shinobi village located in the Land of Keys. This village's shinobi are experts in espionage in order to gain information for negotiations with larger, more powerful nations.
faction.narutorpg.kagero_village.desc: Kagerō Village, was a small village located in the Land of Mountains.
faction.narutorpg.kisaragi_village.desc: Kisaragi Village is a village south of Konohagakure. It was the subject of attacks by bandits in league with the Shirogane clan in their search for the spirit orbs.
faction.narutorpg.missing_nin.desc: Shinobi who abandoned their village. Free, feared, and hunted by every hidden village.
faction.narutorpg.mount_katsuragi.desc: Mount Katsuragi is a mountain which holds the Tsuchigumo clan's kinjutsu. Hotaru and Tonbee live on this mountain.
faction.narutorpg.mount_myoboku.desc: Mount Myōboku, also known as the "Mountain of Bewilderment" and the "Land of Toads", is one of the big three unexplored sage regions, a legendary place that is equally as famous as the other two, Shikkotsu Forest and Ryūchi Cave.
faction.narutorpg.nadeshiko_village.desc: The Nadeshiko Village is a shinobi village located near the Land of Water. The families of this village are organised through matrilineality.
faction.narutorpg.ryuchi_cave.desc: Ryūchi Cave is one of the big three unexplored sage regions, a legendary place that is equally famous as the other two, Mount Myōboku and Shikkotsu Forest.
faction.narutorpg.shangri_la.desc: Shangri-la was a village located in what was sometimes called the Valley of Lies. It was a haven for those with bounties on their heads who wanted to live their lives without worrying about being pursued by bounty hunters.
faction.narutorpg.shikkotsu_forest.desc: The Shikkotsu Forest is a legendary place and one of the three unexplored sage regions; the other two being: Mount Myōboku and Ryūchi Cave.
faction.narutorpg.sugi_village.desc: Sugi Village is an anime-only ninja village, in an unspecified country.
faction.narutorpg.takumi_village.desc: Takumi Village is an anime-only village that resides in the Land of Rivers. It was founded over one hundred years ago by a man named Seimei.
faction.narutorpg.tonika_village.desc: Tonika Village is a village located on the outskirts of the border of the Land of Fire. It is also where The Hole is located.
faction.narutorpg.tree_felling_village.d: The Tree Felling Village, later renamed to the Tree Revival Village, is a small and peaceful village once controlled by a dark demon called Black Shadow, who protected the village in exchange for human sacrifices every couple of years.
faction.narutorpg.tsuchigumo_village.des: The Tsuchigumo village is the village of the Tsuchigumo clan. It is led by the Tsuchigumo chief.
item.narutorpg.absorbing_eye.desc: Absorbs ninjutsu while guarding; fires the stored energy as an anti-regeneration beam.
item.narutorpg.absorbing_hand.desc: Prosthetic that absorbs incoming ninjutsu; punches drain chakra.
item.narutorpg.adamantine_staff.desc: Monkey King's staff: crushing blows, ground slam, and a solid guard.
item.narutorpg.altering_terrain_diagram_: Draw stone walls, or hide traps in the terrain.
item.narutorpg.ama_no_hoko.desc: A shard of the ancient tower: channels a devastating red beam.
item.narutorpg.antidote.desc: Cures poisons. Sneak: splash nearby allies.
item.narutorpg.araya_puppet.desc: Body double puppet that fights in your place.
item.narutorpg.arm_mounted_drill.desc: Tenrō drill: armour-piercing strikes; drills through rock.
item.narutorpg.artificial_sharingan.desc: Cybernetic Sharingan: perfect vision and predictive reflexes.
item.narutorpg.autonomous_puppet.desc: Runs on stored chakra: no upkeep once summoned.
item.narutorpg.axe.desc: Heavy chop that breaks shields; can be thrown.
item.narutorpg.barrier_puppets.desc: Shirogane guardians: erect a barrier, or summon a guard puppet.
item.narutorpg.barrier_tag.desc: Place for a temporary wall. Three or more placed in sequence link into a lasting Barrier Gate.
item.narutorpg.bashosen.desc: Treasured fan producing all five natures. Sneak: hurricane gust.
item.narutorpg.bell_charm.desc: Mystic charm: severing pink rays, or an angelic barrier.
item.narutorpg.benihisago.desc: Treasured gourd that seals the spirit of anyone it records.
item.narutorpg.binding_cloth.desc: Suna cloth: binds targets; with a seal, imprisons them.
item.narutorpg.bingo_book.desc: Read the target's profile; sneak to track every hostile nearby.
item.narutorpg.blowpipe.desc: Silent darts: poison, or sneak for tranquiliser.
item.narutorpg.blue_fire_powder.desc: Explodes violently on contact with water (and anything wet).
item.narutorpg.bo.desc: Long staff: reach, sweeps and parries.
item.narutorpg.book_of_gelel.desc: Secrets of the Stone of Gelel.
item.narutorpg.bow_and_arrow.desc: Precise shot; sneak for a triple volley.
item.narutorpg.box_of_ultimate_bliss.des: Grants a wish of power... or releases what lurks inside.
item.narutorpg.bubble_utilising_pipe.des: Soap-bubble ninjutsu: drifting explosive bubbles; sneak for a bubble guard.
item.narutorpg.chain_wind_staff.desc: Weighted chains on both ends: lash out or spin a wide sweep.
item.narutorpg.chakra_armour.desc: Blocks ninjutsu and genjutsu; sneak to absorb attacks.
Clamps onto a target and drains its chakra.
item.narutorpg.chakra_suppressing_seal.d: Suppresses a target's chakra; sneak to calm yourself.
item.narutorpg.chakra_transmission_commu: Shares the location of every ally and foe.
item.narutorpg.chikamatsu_collection.des: Ten legendary puppets: summons a squad.
item.narutorpg.chilli_pepper_bomb.desc: Fiery cloud that also snaps people out of genjutsu.
item.narutorpg.claw_club.desc: Yagura's hooked club: crushing blows and a reflecting guard.
item.narutorpg.cleaver_sword.desc: Darui's folding cleaver, conducts Storm Release.
item.narutorpg.crossbow.desc: Powerful bolt; sneak for poisoned bolt.
item.narutorpg.curry_of_life.desc: Ferociously spicy curry that revives the body.
item.narutorpg.curse_mask.desc: Power at a price: grants great strength while it devours you.
item.narutorpg.cursed_seal_device.desc: Juinjutsu device: borrowed power, borrowed time.
item.narutorpg.dako.desc: Iō's extending cross-spear: launch the head, or lunge.
item.narutorpg.demon_shinki.desc: A seed that grows into a chakra-sucking demon tree.
item.narutorpg.demonic_flute.desc: Genjutsu melody; sneak to summon Doki.
item.narutorpg.dojutsu_glasses.desc: Borrow a dōjutsu: see through everything.
item.narutorpg.double_bladed_scythe.desc: Ritual scythe made to draw blood.
item.narutorpg.dragon_blade.desc: A blade that lets its wielder perform any technique.
item.narutorpg.elemental_puppets.desc: Red puppet breathes fire; sneak for the blue water puppet.
item.narutorpg.exploding_sphere.desc: Kunai-studded sphere with a hidden explosive tag.
item.narutorpg.explosive_tag.desc: Throw for a timed blast; sneak-place as a proximity trap. Thrown kunai carry one from your off-hand.
item.narutorpg.eye_medicine_plant.desc: Rare herb that soothes eye strain.
item.narutorpg.eye_scope.desc: Deidara's scope: spot and range distant targets.
item.narutorpg.fire_gatling.desc: Rotating barrels unleash stored Fire Release.
item.narutorpg.fire_sword.desc: Emits and wields vast flames; sneak to send a light signal beam.
item.narutorpg.fishing_rod.desc: Urashiki's rod: hooks a target and reels out their chakra.
item.narutorpg.flamethrower.desc: Puppet pipes that spew rock-melting fire.
item.narutorpg.flash_bomb.desc: Blinding flash for a quick escape.
item.narutorpg.flying_destruction_machin: Flying bomber: glide and drop bombs; sneak for the explosive beam.
Throw to place a seal; sneak to warp to it instantly.
item.narutorpg.gama_chan.desc: Naruto's beloved toad wallet. Fortune smiles on the thrifty.
item.narutorpg.garian_sword.desc: Wire-guided three-pronged blade that can be shot at foes.
item.narutorpg.gekkoran_flower.desc: Blooms once a decade; saves lives.
item.narutorpg.genjutsu_nullifying_perfu: Breaks genjutsu through smell; sneak to spray allies.
item.narutorpg.giant_folding_fan.desc: Temari's war fan: cutting winds, or a reflecting guard.
item.narutorpg.gold_dust.desc: Magnetic gold dust that buries foes.
item.narutorpg.gunbai.desc: Uchiha war fan: reflects everything; sneak for a fire-wind blast.
item.narutorpg.hashirama_s_artificial_bo: Cells of the First Hokage: tremendous vitality.
item.narutorpg.hero_water.desc: Multiplies chakra greatly, at the cost of life force.
item.narutorpg.hidden_kunai_mechanism.de: Spring-loaded sleeve kunai: snap them out or launch on a wire.
item.narutorpg.hiramekarei.desc: Twin-hilted blade that stores and releases chakra.
item.narutorpg.hiruko.desc: Puppet armour with a poison tail and senbon launcher.
item.narutorpg.hyuga_clan_secret_ointmen: Healing cream; sneak to share with allies.
item.narutorpg.ice_bomb.desc: Releases a torrent of ice spikes.
item.narutorpg.infinite_armour.desc: Tiger chest plate that absorbs nearly all damage.
item.narutorpg.iron_sand.desc: The Third Kazekage's magnetised iron sand.
item.narutorpg.jidanda.desc: Spiked explosive iron ball on a chain.
item.narutorpg.johyo.desc: Rope dart: whip it out or reel targets in.
item.narutorpg.kabutowari.desc: Axe and hammer that splits any defence.
item.narutorpg.kohaku_no_johei.desc: The pot seals anyone who answers its call.
item.narutorpg.kokinjo.desc: Golden rope that draws out the soul.
item.narutorpg.kubikiribocho.desc: The Executioner's Blade. It reforges itself from blood (sneak: heal).
item.narutorpg.kunai.desc: Stab, or throw. Throwing with an Explosive Tag in your off-hand makes an explosive kunai.
item.narutorpg.kuroari.desc: Trap puppet: captures targets inside its body.
item.narutorpg.kurosawa.desc: Mifune's sword: iai strike and samurai parry.
item.narutorpg.kusarigama.desc: Sickle and chain: lash, entangle, or throw.
item.narutorpg.lightning_barrel.desc: Tap to call down a bolt of lightning.
item.narutorpg.liquid_crystal_wall.desc: Projects a wall of liquid crystal particles.
item.narutorpg.magnum_opus.desc: Archive of every ninjutsu ever recorded.
item.narutorpg.metal_doll.desc: Huge iron doll: summon it, or hurl it.
item.narutorpg.metal_gauntlets.desc: Demon Brothers' clawed gauntlets with a shuriken chain.
item.narutorpg.meteorite.desc: Star-metal: hurl it, or draw on its chakra.
item.narutorpg.mind_awakening_pill.desc: Forces the cursed seal to level two.
item.narutorpg.nuibari.desc: Sewing needle sword that stitches foes together.
item.narutorpg.ocarina.desc: Strengthens allies; frees them from genjutsu.
item.narutorpg.odourless_poison_mist.des: Dulls the senses of anyone who breathes it.
item.narutorpg.palace_of_the_dragon_king: Black box releasing a petrifying gas.
item.narutorpg.paw_encyclopaedia.desc: A book of cat paw prints.
item.narutorpg.pepper_balloon_earrings.d: Pepper spray for a quick escape.
item.narutorpg.poison.desc: Throw a poison vial; sneak to coat your weapons (strength).
item.narutorpg.prayer_beads.desc: Sticks to and binds the sealed.
item.narutorpg.puppet.desc: Basic puppet controlled with chakra threads.
item.narutorpg.puppet_buzzsaw.desc: Spinning saw from the Third Kazekage's arm.
item.narutorpg.retractable_shield.desc: Gauntlet that opens into a shield.
item.narutorpg.sand_gourd.desc: Gaara's gourd: Sand Coffin; sneak for an absolute defence.
item.narutorpg.sasori_puppet.desc: Sasori's own body: flamethrowers and blades.
item.narutorpg.sealing_tag.desc: Seal a weakened foe, or bind one at range.
item.narutorpg.senbon.desc: Needles: fan of three, or a nerve strike (sneak).
item.narutorpg.shichiseiken.desc: Treasured sword that seals by its curse.
item.narutorpg.shinobi_gauntlet.desc: Fires stored ninjutsu scrolls, no chakra needed.
item.narutorpg.shuigu.desc: Golden cane that produces limitless water.
item.narutorpg.shuriken.desc: Throw one; sneak for a fan of three.
item.narutorpg.slime_suit.desc: Mucus membrane that slips every blow.
item.narutorpg.space_time_gate.desc: Set a gate anchor; sneak to warp back.
item.narutorpg.spirit_orbs.desc: Materialised will of the Master Puppet.
item.narutorpg.steam_armour.desc: Boil Release armour; sneak to vent scalding steam.
item.narutorpg.storage_scroll.desc: Storage scroll: unseal a rain of weapons.
item.narutorpg.sword_of_kusanagi_orochim: Extends and flies at its master's will.
item.narutorpg.sword_of_kusanagi_sasuke_: Chidori Current flows through the blade.
item.narutorpg.sword_of_nunoboko.desc: Truth-Seeking helix blade of the Sage.
item.narutorpg.tailed_beast_drug.desc: Capsules that trigger a tailed-beast transformation.
item.narutorpg.tea_kettle.desc: Bunpuku's kettle: a scalding steam bomb.
item.narutorpg.three_coloured_pills.desc: Akimichi pills: overwhelming power, terrible aftermath.
item.narutorpg.tobishachimaru.desc: Flying ship: soar across the land.
item.narutorpg.tonfa.desc: Close-combat batons; also used for dowsing.
item.narutorpg.umbrella.desc: Senbon rain; sneak to float down.
item.narutorpg.vampire_puppet.desc: Bloodthirsty puppet that drains its prey.
item.narutorpg.water_stream_shooters.des: Pressurised water jets; sneak for a cutting stream.
item.narutorpg.weaknessless_soaring_shor: Twin jian that answer every attack.
item.narutorpg.weights.desc: Training weights: slow you while worn; sneak-use to drop them for a burst of speed.
item.narutorpg.wrist_launcher.desc: Eight barrels of smoke: plain, or sneak for poison.
item.narutorpg.yata_mirror.desc: Ethereal shield that negates any attack.
lineage.narutorpg.aburame.desc: The Aburame Clan is a well-known clan of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.akimichi.desc: The Akimichi Clan is a well known clan of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.amagiri.desc: The Amagiri Clan is a clan that founded Yumegakure, and one of the three clans that hail from the village.
lineage.narutorpg.chinoike.desc: The Chinoike Clan was a clan active during the Warring States Period.
lineage.narutorpg.clanless.desc: No bloodline - only the academy basics and hard work.
lineage.narutorpg.fuma.desc: The Fūma Clan is a renowned ninja clan distantly related to the Uchiha Clan, famous in at least Amegakure and the Land of Fire.
lineage.narutorpg.fuma_sound.desc: The Fūma Clan is a shinobi clan from the Land of the Rice Fields, where Orochimaru established the Land of Sound.
lineage.narutorpg.funato.desc: The Funato Clan is a clan of pirates in the Land of Water.
lineage.narutorpg.hagoromo.desc: The is one of the earlier clans which existed during the war-torn era preceding the creation of the hidden villages.
lineage.narutorpg.hatake.desc: The Hatake Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.hirasaka.desc: The Hirasaka Clan is one of the three clans that hail from Yumegakure.
lineage.narutorpg.hoki.desc: The Hōki Family is a matrilineal shinobi clan (and family) of medical-nin and information gatherers from Sunagakure, who originated in and moved down to the village of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.hoshigaki.desc: This shinobi clan is from Kirigakure.
lineage.narutorpg.hozuki.desc: The Hōzuki Clan is a group of ninja that settled in Kirigakure after the ending of the Warring States Period.
lineage.narutorpg.hyuga.desc: The Hyūga Clan or Hyūga Family is a well known clan of Konohagakure, as well as the strongest clan in the village, standing alongside the Uchiha Clan, with the Hyūga said to also possess the oldest and most...
lineage.narutorpg.iburi.desc: The Iburi Clan was a seclusive clan that lived underground in the Land of Fire.
lineage.narutorpg.inuzuka.desc: The Inuzuka Clan or Inuzuka Family is a family of shinobi in Konohagakure known for their use of ninken as fighting companions and are easily identified by the distinctive red fang markings on their cheeks.
lineage.narutorpg.izuno.desc: The Izuno Clan is a family of shinobi in Konohagakure known for their use of cat-inspired ninjutsu.
lineage.narutorpg.jugo.desc: This clan is an unnamed family, which originated from an unknown area.
lineage.narutorpg.kagetsu.desc: The Kagetsu Family hail from Motoyoshi Village within the Land of Fire.
lineage.narutorpg.kaguya.desc: The Kaguya Clan is a now extinct clan, known for their savage battle tactics and archaic values, and as descendants of Kaguya Ōtsutsuki, a select few have inherited a derivative of her original ability to manipulate...
lineage.narutorpg.kamizuru.desc: The Kamizuru Clan was a clan of bee users from Iwagakure who were once very well-known and revered.
lineage.narutorpg.karatachi.desc: This family was a group of people from Kirigakure, which has produced renowned shinobi.
lineage.narutorpg.kazekage.desc: This shinobi clan from Sunagakure holds high influential authority in its village.
lineage.narutorpg.kedoin.desc: The Kedōin Clan is a small clan led by Agari Kaisen.
lineage.narutorpg.kodon.desc: The Kodon Clan is a clan of the Howling Wolf Village.
lineage.narutorpg.kohaku.desc: The Kohaku Clan was a shinobi clan that had a village near the border of the Land of Fire to that of Amegakure.
lineage.narutorpg.kumanoi.desc: The Kumanoi Clan was a clan of the Howling Wolf Village.
lineage.narutorpg.kurama.desc: The Kurama Clan is a clan of extremely skilled genjutsu users, exclusive to the anime.
lineage.narutorpg.lee.desc: The Lee Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.nara.desc: The Nara Clan or Nara Family is one of the many clans of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.onikuma.desc: The Onikuma Clan is one of the many clans that reside in Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.otsutsuki.desc: The Ōtsutsuki Clan is an ancient clan of horned humanoid creatures known as celestial beings, and also described as aliens from another planet, and revered as equivalent to gods.
lineage.narutorpg.rinha.desc: The Rinha Clan was a clan with specialists in medical ninjutsu.
lineage.narutorpg.ryu.desc: The Ryū Clan was once a powerful clan of Dragon Guardians entrusted with keeping the Dragon Blade.
lineage.narutorpg.sarutobi.desc: The Sarutobi Clan is an influential clan from Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.sendo.desc: The Sendō Clan is a clan of the Howling Wolf Village led by Jiryū Sendō.
lineage.narutorpg.senju.desc: The Senju Clan was one of the clans responsible for founding the first shinobi village: Konohagakure — the other being their rival Uchiha Clan.
lineage.narutorpg.shiin.desc: The Shiin Clan was a small shinobi clan from the Land of the Rice Fields, where Orochimaru established the Land of Sound.
lineage.narutorpg.shimura.desc: The Shimura Clan is a shinobi clan from Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.shirogane.desc: The Shirogane Clan was a puppet clan from the Land of Wind.
lineage.narutorpg.taketori.desc: The Taketori Clan is a clan, presumably outside of Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.tenro.desc: The Tenrō Clan is a clan of shinobi that hail from Yumegakure.
lineage.narutorpg.tsuchigumo.desc: The Tsuchigumo Clan is a clan that formed a pact with the Third Hokage during the Third Shinobi World War.
lineage.narutorpg.uchiha.desc: The Uchiha Clan is a well-known clan of Konohagakure, reputed to be the village's strongest because of their elite battle prowess and the Sharingan.
lineage.narutorpg.uzumaki.desc: The Uzumaki Clan was a formerly prominent clan in Uzushiogakure.
lineage.narutorpg.wagarashi.desc: The Wagarashi Family is a clan in the Land of Tea.
lineage.narutorpg.wasabi.desc: The Wasabi Family is a clan from the Land of Tea.
lineage.narutorpg.yamanaka.desc: The Yamanaka Clan is a family of shinobi found in Konohagakure.
lineage.narutorpg.yoimura.desc: The Yoimura Clan is a clan that resides in Daidai Village.
lineage.narutorpg.yota.desc: This travelling clan had the ability to manipulate weather, which they used for their trades.
lineage.narutorpg.yotsuki.desc: The Yotsuki Clan is a clan from Kumogakure.
lineage.narutorpg.yuki.desc: The Yuki Clan lived in the Land of Water.
